summary_executive: Mineração de repositórios para 'phaser javascript game framework'. Identificados 3 repositórios existentes com componentes de alta qualidade para evitar reinventar a roda.

sources.title: phaserjs/phaser
sources.summary: Phaser is a fun, free and fast 2D game framework for making HTML5 games for desktop and mobile web browsers, supporting Canvas and WebGL rendering.

sources.title: phaserjs/phaser-ce
sources.summary: Phaser CE is a fun, free and fast 2D game framework for making HTML5 games for desktop and mobile web browsers, supporting Canvas and WebGL rendering.

sources.title: pablogozalvez/Super-Mario-Phaser
sources.summary: Recreation of the classic Super Mario Bros game using the Phaser framework, with random level generation.
